checks.beta_identity_invitations_consumed_shape: ("consumed_at" IS NULL AND "consumed_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "consumed_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
checks.beta_identity_invitations_revoked_shape: ("revoked_at" IS NULL AND "revoked_by_admin_principal_id" IS NULL AND "revoke_request_id_hash" IS NULL AND "revoke_payload_hash" IS NULL) OR ("revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_by_admin_principal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "revoke_request_id_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "revoke_payload_hash" IS NOT NULL)
checks.beta_identity_invitations_terminal_exclu: NOT ("consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

checks.health_no_session_observations_columns_m:
"observation"->>'providerId'="provider_id" AND "observation"->>'surfaceId'="observation_surface_id"
    AND "observation"->>'targetKey'="target_key" AND "observation"->>'strategyId'="strategy_id"
    AND ("observation"->>'strategyRevision')::integer="strategy_revision"
    AND "observation"->>'classification'="classification"
    AND "observation"->>'classificationBasis'="classification_basis"
    AND "observation"->>'surfaceOutcome'="surface_outcome"
    AND "observation"->>'blocker'="blocker"
    AND ("observation"->>'observedAt')::timestamptz="observed_at"

checks.health_no_session_run_receipts_projectio: ("normalized_result_sha256" IS NULL AND "projection_applied_at" IS NULL) OR ("normalized_result_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "projection_applied_at" IS NOT NULL)

checks.health_no_session_scope_states_baseline_:
("accepted_baseline_run_id" IS NULL AND "accepted_baseline_result_sha256" IS NULL AND "accepted_baseline_health_state" IS NULL AND "accepted_baseline_at" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("accepted_baseline_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "accepted_baseline_result_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "accepted_baseline_health_state"='HEALTHY' AND "accepted_baseline_at" IS NOT NULL)

checks.health_notification_intents_claim_pair: "state" <> 'CLAIMED' OR ("claim_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

checks.monitor_profile_repair_operations_result:
("state"='IN_PROGRESS' AND "committed_at" IS NULL AND "published_profile_revision_id" IS NULL AND "assignment_revision_id" IS NULL AND "result" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("state"='COMMITTED' AND "committed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "published_profile_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assignment_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("result")='object')

checks.admin_maintenance_grants_check1: (previous_token_hash IS NULL AND rotation_nonce_hash IS NULL AND rotation_replay_until IS NULL) OR (previous_token_hash IS NOT NULL AND rotation_nonce_hash IS NOT NULL AND rotation_replay_until IS NOT NULL)
checks.admin_maintenance_grants_check2: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at

checks.account_connection_credentials_revocatio: (revoked_at IS NULL AND revocation_reason IS NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at >= created_at AND revocation_reason IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: plan_revisions_publication_state_time
canonicalChecks.expression: ("state" = 'DRAFT' AND "published_at" IS NULL) OR ("state" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "published_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: plan_entitlements_exactly_one_value
canonicalChecks.expression: ("boolean_value" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("integer_value" IS NOT NULL)::integer = 1

canonicalChecks.name: account_entitlement_overrides_exactly_one_value_for_set
canonicalChecks.expression: "operation" = 'CLEAR' OR (("boolean_value" IS NOT NULL)::integer + ("integer_value" IS NOT NULL)::integer = 1)

canonicalChecks.name: account_entitlement_overrides_clear_has_no_value
canonicalChecks.expression: "operation" <> 'CLEAR' OR ("boolean_value" IS NULL AND "integer_value" IS NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: price_revisions_publication_state_time
canonicalChecks.expression: ("state" = 'DRAFT' AND "published_at" IS NULL) OR ("state" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "published_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: subscription_transitions_revision_origin
canonicalChecks.expression: ("transition_revision" = 1 AND "from_state" IS NULL) OR ("transition_revision" > 1 AND "from_state" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: billing_reconciliation_jobs_ready_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: "state" <> 'READY' OR ("next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL AND "lease_token" IS NULL AND "lease_until" IS NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: billing_reconciliation_jobs_leased_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: "state" <> 'LEASED' OR ("next_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "lease_until" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: billing_reconciliation_jobs_terminal_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: "state" NOT IN ('SETTLED','BLOCKED') OR ("next_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "lease_token" IS NULL AND "lease_until" IS NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: admin_role_grants_revocation_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: ("revoked_at" IS NULL AND "revoked_by_admin_principal_id" IS NULL) OR ("revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_by_admin_principal_id" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: admin_sessions_revoke_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: ("revoked_at" IS NULL AND "revoke_reason" IS NULL) OR ("revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoke_reason" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: adapter_profile_revisions_publication_state_time
canonicalChecks.expression: ("state" IN ('DRAFT', 'CANDIDATE') AND "published_at" IS NULL) OR ("state" IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') AND "published_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: adapter_profile_assignment_revisions_shape
canonicalChecks.expression:
("mode" = 'DIRECT' AND "candidate_profile_revision_id" IS NULL AND "percentage_bps" = 0) OR
    ("mode" IN ('ROLLOUT', 'PAUSED') AND "candidate_profile_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "baseline_profile_revision_id" <> "candidate_profile_revision_id")

canonicalChecks.name: health_incidents_resolution_pair
canonicalChecks.expression: ("resolved_by_run_id" IS NULL AND "resolved_at" IS NULL) OR ("resolved_by_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: health_notification_intents_claim_pair
canonicalChecks.expression: "state" <> 'CLAIMED' OR ("claim_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: health_runs_kind_shape
canonicalChecks.expression:
("run_kind"='BASELINE_CONTOUR' AND "suite_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "extension_version" IS NOT NULL AND "adapter_engine_version" IS NOT NULL)
  OR ("run_kind"='NO_SESSION_OBSERVATION' AND "suite_revision_id" IS NULL AND "extension_version" IS NULL AND "adapter_engine_version" IS NULL AND "scheduled_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "health_level"='H2' AND "operator_maintenance"=false AND "operator_maintenance_authority" IS NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: health_no_session_observations_columns_match
canonicalChecks.expression:
"observation"->>'providerId'="provider_id" AND "observation"->>'surfaceId'="observation_surface_id"
    AND "observation"->>'targetKey'="target_key" AND "observation"->>'strategyId'="strategy_id"
    AND ("observation"->>'strategyRevision')::integer="strategy_revision"
    AND "observation"->>'classification'="classification"
    AND "observation"->>'classificationBasis'="classification_basis"
    AND "observation"->>'surfaceOutcome'="surface_outcome"
    AND "observation"->>'blocker'="blocker"
    AND ("observation"->>'observedAt')::timestamptz="observed_at"

canonicalChecks.name: device_authorizations_client_metadata_shape
canonicalChecks.expression:
("browser_family" IS NULL AND "browser_version" IS NULL AND "extension_version" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("browser_family" IS NOT NULL AND "extension_version" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: devices_client_metadata_shape
canonicalChecks.expression:
("browser_family" IS NULL AND "browser_version_last_seen" IS NULL AND "extension_version_last_seen" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("browser_family" IS NOT NULL AND "extension_version_last_seen" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: health_no_session_run_receipts_projection_pair
canonicalChecks.expression: ("normalized_result_sha256" IS NULL AND "projection_applied_at" IS NULL) OR ("normalized_result_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "projection_applied_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: health_no_session_scope_states_baseline_shape
canonicalChecks.expression:
("accepted_baseline_run_id" IS NULL AND "accepted_baseline_result_sha256" IS NULL AND "accepted_baseline_health_state" IS NULL AND "accepted_baseline_at" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("accepted_baseline_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "accepted_baseline_result_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "accepted_baseline_health_state"='HEALTHY' AND "accepted_baseline_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: monitor_profile_repair_operations_result_shape
canonicalChecks.expression:
("state"='IN_PROGRESS' AND "committed_at" IS NULL AND "published_profile_revision_id" IS NULL AND "assignment_revision_id" IS NULL AND "result" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("state"='COMMITTED' AND "committed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "published_profile_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "assignment_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("result")='object')

canonicalChecks.name: beta_identity_invitations_consumed_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: ("consumed_at" IS NULL AND "consumed_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "consumed_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: beta_identity_invitations_revoked_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: ("revoked_at" IS NULL AND "revoked_by_admin_principal_id" IS NULL AND "revoke_request_id_hash" IS NULL AND "revoke_payload_hash" IS NULL) OR ("revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_by_admin_principal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "revoke_request_id_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "revoke_payload_hash" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: beta_identity_invitations_terminal_exclusive
canonicalChecks.expression: NOT ("consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: admin_maintenance_grants_check1
canonicalChecks.expression: (previous_token_hash IS NULL AND rotation_nonce_hash IS NULL AND rotation_replay_until IS NULL) OR (previous_token_hash IS NOT NULL AND rotation_nonce_hash IS NOT NULL AND rotation_replay_until IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: admin_maintenance_grants_check2
canonicalChecks.expression: revoked_at IS NULL OR revoked_at >= created_at

canonicalChecks.name: account_connection_credentials_revocation_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: (revoked_at IS NULL AND revocation_reason IS NULL) OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at >= created_at AND revocation_reason IS NOT NULL)

canonicalChecks.name: devices_credential_transfer_approval_shape
canonicalChecks.expression: (credential_transfer_approved_at IS NULL AND credential_transfer_approved_by_user_id IS NULL) OR (credential_transfer_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND credential_transfer_approved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL)

sqlOwnedConstraints.name: device_authorizations_p2_3_secret_state
sqlOwnedConstraints.expression:
"idempotency_key_hash" IS NULL OR
    (("status" IN ('PENDING','APPROVED')) = ("start_secret_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "start_secret_nonce" IS NOT NULL AND "start_secret_auth_tag" IS NOT NULL))

sqlOwnedConstraints.name: device_authorizations_p2_3_fingerprint
sqlOwnedConstraints.expression: "idempotency_key_hash" IS NULL OR "request_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL

sqlOwnedConstraints.name: device_authorizations_p2_5_exchanged
sqlOwnedConstraints.expression: status <> 'EXCHANGED' OR (exchanged_at IS NOT NULL AND exchange_idempotency_key_hash IS NOT NULL AND exchange_replay_until IS NOT NULL AND exchanged_device_id IS NOT NULL AND exchanged_session_id IS NOT NULL AND start_secret_ciphertext IS NULL AND start_secret_nonce IS NULL AND start_secret_auth_tag IS NULL)
